why: Mark (19 Nov 2026): every special and trap image must convey the card's actual in-game effect as a tongue-in-cheek gag. Remade in Gemini from effect-led prompts, in batches.
generator: Gemini (Mark's Google AI Plus plan), by hand at gemini.google.com, one new chat per image, no reference image. Not called from the repo. Fal and other hosted generators remain banned.
pipeline: scripts/inpaint-card-art-fooocus.py --export-from (768x1024 WebP plate), then npm run art:thumbs --force (thumb/mid WebP+AVIF)
design_record: art/bear-bibles.json holds each card's signature (kind trap/special); CARD_ART holds the short visual/scene.

A red rotating bleep light above the door flashes. Palette: concrete grey, locker steel blue, bleep red. Hyper-realistic real-world photograph, not an illustration, not a painting, not a cartoon, not 3D render, not CGI. Full-frame DSLR, real lens optics, true-to-life lighting, physically accurate shadows and reflections, natural material texture, fine film grain. Every character is an adult plush teddy bear toy (a real stuffed toy with visible fabric fibres and stitching, not a living animal, not a human), photographed in a real location; cheeky adult humour by innuendo only. No wooden bar counter, no wood panelling, no shelves of liquor bottles, no warm amber, orange or brown light. Portrait 3:4, subject centred with headroom for a card frame. No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, signage, screens with words or watermark anywhere. No humans, no human faces, no human hands, no children.
